description: This header defines utility functions, classes, and data structures for managing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) operations within PyTorch's MPS backend. It includes GPU tensor handling, graph caching, kernel caching, and Metal shader execution wrappers specifically tailored for MPS integration.

classes.name: MPSScalar
classes.description: Represents a scalar value stored in a Metal buffer with associated type information.

classes.name: Placeholder
classes.description: Encapsulates a placeholder tensor or tensor data for GPU operations within an MPS graph.

classes.name: MPSCachedKernel
classes.description: Wraps a cached GPU kernel object.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: Base class for caching MPS computational graphs.

classes.name: MPSUnaryCachedGraph
classes.description: Caches unary MPS graphs with input and output tensors.

classes.name: MPSUnaryGradCachedGraph
classes.description: Caches unary gradient MPS graphs with tensors for gradient computation.

classes.name: MPSBinaryCachedGraph
classes.description: Caches binary MPS graphs involving two tensors.

classes.name: MPSBinaryGradCachedGraph
classes.description: Caches binary gradient graphs for two tensors.

classes.name: MPSKernelCache
classes.description: Singleton class managing caching of GPU kernels.

classes.name: MPSGraphCache
classes.description: Singleton class managing caching of MPS graphs.

classes.name: MetalShaderLibrary
classes.description: Manages Metal shader functions and kernel execution (indirectly referenced via functions).

methods.name: runMPSGraph
methods.description: Executes an MPS graph with provided feeds and stores the result in a Placeholder.

methods.name: getMPSDataType
methods.description: Returns the MPS data type for a given scalar type or tensor.

methods.name: getMPSScalar
methods.description: Converts a Scalar object to an MPSScalar.

methods.name: getMPSTypeString
methods.description: Returns string representation of MPS data types.

methods.name: scalarToMetalTypeString
methods.description: Gets Metal-specific string for scalar types.

methods.name: getTensorAxes
methods.description: Returns axes of a tensor as an array of NSNumber.

methods.name: getMPSShapeString
methods.description: Generates a string description of an MPS shape.

methods.name: getTensorsStringKey
methods.description: Creates a string key representing tensor list with options.

methods.name: to_hex_key
methods.description: Converts a float value into a hexadecimal string key.

methods.name: getArrayRefString
methods.description: Returns string representation of an IntArrayRef.

methods.name: gatherViewTensor
methods.description: Creates a tensor view based on storage.

methods.name: scatterViewTensor
methods.description: Scatters a tensor view into the output tensor.

methods.name: castToIHFTypes
methods.description: Casts a tensor to integer, half, or float types suitable for Metal shaders.

methods.name: castFromIHFTypes
methods.description: Casts tensors from IHF types back to a specified type.

methods.name: getStridedMPSNDArray
methods.description: Returns an MPSNDArray with strided shape from a tensor.

methods.name: getMPSNDArray
methods.description: Creates an MPSNDArray from a tensor with optional sizes and strides.

methods.name: getTensorView
methods.description: Returns a tensor view with a specific shape.

methods.name: getMPSShape
methods.description: Determines MPS shape from tensor.

methods.name: isTooLargeForMPSGraph
methods.description: Checks if a tensor exceeds size limits for MPS graph processing.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Computes log(1 + input) using MPS graph.

methods.name: compute_storage_numel_distance
methods.description: Calculates distance between storage offsets for tensors.

methods.name: is_dense_in_storage
methods.description: Checks if a tensor's storage is contiguous.

methods.name: supportedFloatingType
methods.description: Checks if a scalar type is supported for floating point operations in Metal/MPS.

methods.name: supportedFloatingOrComplexType
methods.description: Includes support for complex types along with floating types.

methods.name: needsGather
methods.description: Determines whether tensor data needs to be gathered for MPS processing based on device and storage layout.

methods.name: exec_unary_kernel_with_params
methods.description: Executes a Metal shader kernel for unary tensor operations with parameters.

methods.name: exec_binary_kernel_with_params
methods.description: Executes a Metal shader kernel for binary tensor operations with parameters.

methods.name: is_dense_broadcastable
methods.description: Checks if one tensor can be broadcasted into another assuming contiguous layout.

methods.name: maximumWithNaNPropagationAndIntFallbackWithPrimaryTensor:secondaryTensor:name:(MPSGraphTensor*,MPSGraphTensor*,NSString*)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: minimumWithNaNPropagationAndIntFallbackWithPrimaryTensor:secondaryTensor:name:(MPSGraphTensor*,MPSGraphTensor*,NSString*)
methods.description: unavailable
